## Purpose and scope

Describe the change, linked Roadmap item, risks and rollback.

## OpenSpec metadata

Use the applicable standalone lines from [SDD compliance](../docs/SDD_COMPLIANCE.md).
Proposal PRs declare `OpenSpec-Change` and `OpenSpec-Phase: proposal`.
Implementation PRs also declare approval PR, documentation review and archive evidence.

## Verification

- [ ] Scope and acceptance scenarios reviewed
- [ ] OpenSpec and repository checks reported
- [ ] Actual Forever build and client checks reported as passed, failed or NOT RUN
- [ ] Documentation, privacy and localization reviewed where applicable
